header: I keep the NON-PERMANENT (contractual or temporary) doctors of the hospital apart from the permanent doctors (step 52a). What is here: every doctor of the intranet's "Select Doctor" list whose number is not a plain 6-digit ticket: "D" + 6 digits (51 doctors) or "DTN" + digits (15 doctors), 66 in all (read from the list I showed on 24 Oct 2026). My rule: a permanent doctor has a ticket of at most 6 digits; a non-permanent doctor's number has letters first. Not here: Dr. Manish Kumar (listed as D490196: a stray D, he is permanent with ticket 490196) and Dr. Debdip Saha 490107 (permanent); the doctor of the same name with D499964 IS here. How it grows: the SPECIALIZATION (and the department, the qualification) of most of these doctors is not known yet. When I collect it, edit the entry: set `specialization` (and `department`, `qualification`); nothing else needs to change. `staffId` links an entry to the person in data/hospital_staff.json when the hospital's staff list or the OPD schedule has him or her (then the department and the qualification come from there). A doctor who turns out to be permanent: delete the entry and give him or her the ticket in hospital_staff.json. Why a TypeScript file and not a database table: I chose it because the list is short and edited by hand, the compiler checks every edit, no SQL migration is needed, and it can move into a table later (when there is an admin screen) without changing the questions that use it.

members.name: name
doc: I store the name as the intranet doctor list prints it (without "Dr").

members.name: listId
doc: Number as the intranet doctor list shows it: "D" + 6 digits or "DTN" + digits.

members.name: staffId
doc: Points to the person in data/hospital_staff.json, set only when the hospital's own lists have this doctor.

symbols.name: unlistedAsPeople
doc: I return the entries the hospital's own lists do not have as people, so that a question about them finds them (their OPD days are not known).
